snippet.title: Quake Minus One - C64 Longplay / Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Except the title, this game have nothing to do with the much more famous game from ID Software.
This is a strategy game by Monolith/Beyond in 1985, it is for C64 and probably one of the hardest games ever seen on the home computer by Commodore.
The game take place in a large power plant named Titan.
Titan is under the control of five separate computers: Zeus, Poseidon, Vulcan, Ares and Hermes.
The game start with you controlling Hermes robot units and  the AI is maneuvering its robots to take control of Hermes
Yes, you guess right, you are alone against four types of enemy units controlled by the CPU.
You can repair or recharge your units, but defense will not save you, you will need a aggressive stance if you wanna have a chance of victory.

The game is very complicated for a C64 game, so i made a little tutorial that explain all the main features, the map and the weapons.
The longplay start at 1:35
